_about: Screening of Replay candidates against eval/SCORING.md R3 (S1-S8).
screened: 2026-10-27 by Claude (AI) from registry records; every decision is to be checked by the user. S2 values need extraction from the primary paper and a second-person check; S8 needs Data Support Gate counts.
operational_rules: Stage A (search hits only, registry fields): S1 fails if the design model is not parallel, factorial or crossover; S3 fails if the minimum age is under 18 or not given; S4 fails if no intervention is a drug, biological, procedure, dietary supplement or combination product; S2 fails if the record links no result publication and posts no primary analysis with a CI.

Stage B: the remaining search hits, the parity trials and the named candidates, judged on S1-S7 from the registry record. Interventions never used in US practice (investigational agents) fail S4. Items marked unmappable in the 2026-10-27 MIMIC item reviews (LR, blood components, enteral formulas, delirium assessments, position) make the dependent trials fail S4 or S6 until revisited.
uncertain: one criterion needs a check (named in 'failed') before the trial is included or excluded.
